About the shop

Bakhtawar Sweets & Bakers is a neighbourhood sweets and bakers shop in Macca Colony, Gulberg-III, Lahore. The shop offers traditional sweets alongside everyday bakery items — the kind of place local families turn to for mithai and fresh bakes close to home.

For availability or timings, please call the shop directly — the team will guide you on what is available on the day.
